About Reykjavik

Reykjavik is the gateway to Iceland's otherworldly landscapes — geysers, glaciers, waterfalls and, in winter, the northern lights.

Best time to visit Reykjavik

The sweet spot is generally Jun–Aug (mild) / Sep–Mar (auroras) — and the cheapest fares often land just outside peak season.

Top things to do in Reykjavik

  • Soak in the Blue Lagoon
  • Drive the Golden Circle (geyser, falls, rift)
  • Hunt the aurora (Sep-Apr)
  • Walk colorful downtown Reykjavik
  • Watch whales from the old harbor

Good to know

Very safe. Language: Icelandic. Visa for US passports: Visa-free, 90 days.
